name: Deploy to Azure Functions
'on':
  push:
    branches:
    - dev

    - pipeline/Code/**
    - .github/workflows/deploy-pipelines.yml

  deploy:

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
      with:
        fetch-depth: 1
    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v5
      with:
        python-version: '3.12'
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: 'cd pipeline/Code

        pip install -r requirements-pipeline.txt

        pip install -r ../../Code/Shared/ops/tools/requirements.txt

        '
    - name: Derive environment from branch
      id: env
      run: "BRANCH="${GITHUB_REF_NAME}"
if [ "$BRANCH" = "main" ]; then
  echo "name=prod" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
else
  echo "name=$BRANCH" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
fi
echo "Environment: $BRANCH"
"
    - name: Login to Azure
      uses: azure/login@v2
      with:
        creds: ${{ secrets.AZURE_CREDENTIALS }}
    - name: Check for active orchestrations (no overrides — blocks on any error)
      run: "# Rule: if we cannot CONFIRM zero active jobs, we block.
# There are no override flags and no escape hatches.
# The only way to unblock a deploy is to terminate the running job.

MASTER_KEY=$(az functionapp keys list \
  --resource-group FindCareDataPipelines-Dev \
  --name ${{ secrets.AZURE_FUNCTION_APP_NAME }} \
  --query "masterKey" -o tsv 2>/dev/null) || MASTER_KEY=""

if [ -z "$MASTER_KEY" ]; then
  echo "DEPLOY BLOCKED: Cannot retrieve master key — cannot verify no pipeline is running."
  exit 1
fi

# Flex Consumption uses a longer hostname; fetch it from Azure rather than
# constructing <appname>.azurewebsites.net which does not resolve for FC apps.
DEFAULT_HOST=$(az functionapp show \
  --resource-group FindCareDataPipelines-Dev \
  --name ${{ secrets.AZURE_FUNCTION_APP_NAME }} \
  --query "properties.defaultHostName" -o tsv 2>/dev/null) || DEFAULT_HOST=""

if [ -z "$DEFAULT_HOST" ]; then
  echo "DEPLOY BLOCKED: Cannot retrieve app hostname — cannot verify no pipeline is running."
  exit 1
fi

APP_URL="https://${DEFAULT_HOST}"
BASE="${APP_URL}/runtime/webhooks/durabletask/instances?taskHub=DevPipelineManagmentService&code=${MASTER_KEY}"

# Kick the cold start immediately — fire-and-forget, response not checked.
curl -s --max-time 5 "${BASE}&runtimeStatus=Running" -o /dev/null 2>/dev/null || true

# Poll until the app responds or 6 minutes elapse.
# After OOM recovery the Durable extension can take 3-5 min to initialize
# against a large task hub. Each attempt: 20s timeout. Retry every 20s.
query_instances() {
  local status=$1
  local deadline=$((SECONDS + 360))
  while [ $SECONDS -lt $deadline ]; do
    resp=$(curl -s --max-time 20 "${BASE}&runtimeStatus=${status}" 2>/dev/null)
    if echo "$resp" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); isinstance(d,list) or sys.exit(1)" 2>/dev/null; then
      echo "$resp"
      return 0
    fi
    echo "Waiting for app warm-up (${status})..."
    sleep 20
  done
  return 1
}

RUNNING_RESP=$(query_instances "Running") || {
  echo "DEPLOY BLOCKED: Could not query running instances — cannot verify safety."
  exit 1
}
PENDING_RESP=$(query_instances "Pending") || {
  echo "DEPLOY BLOCKED: Could not query pending instances — cannot verify safety."
  exit 1
}

RUNNING=$(echo "$RUNNING_RESP" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); sys.exit(1) if not isinstance(d,list) else print(len(d))") || { echo "DEPLOY BLOCKED: Unexpected Running response: $RUNNING_RESP"; exit 1; }

PENDING=$(echo "$PENDING_RESP" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); sys.exit(1) if not isinstance(d,list) else print(len(d))") || { echo "DEPLOY BLOCKED: Unexpected Pending response: $PENDING_RESP"; exit 1; }

echo "Guard check — Running: ${RUNNING}  Pending: ${PENDING}"

TOTAL=$((RUNNING + PENDING))
if [ "$TOTAL" -gt 0 ]; then
  echo "DEPLOY BLOCKED: ${RUNNING} running + ${PENDING} pending orchestration(s) active."
  echo "Terminate all pipeline runs before deploying orchestrator changes."
  exit 1
fi

echo "Guard passed — no active orchestrations."
"
    - name: Deploy to Azure Functions
      run: "cd pipeline/Code
cp requirements-pipeline.txt requirements.txt
zip -r deploy.zip . --exclude "*.pyc" --exclude "__pycache__/*" --exclude "venv/*" --exclude "venv_func/*" --exclude "local.settings.json" --exclude ".env"
az functionapp deployment source config-zip \
  --resource-group FindCareDataPipelines-Dev \
  --name ${{ secrets.AZURE_FUNCTION_APP_NAME }} \

"

name: Promote Build Between Environments
'on':
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      from_env:
        description: Source environment
        required: true
        type: choice
        options:
        - dev
        - qa
      to_env:
        description: Target environment
        required: true
        type: choice
        options:
        - qa
        - prod
      confirm_prod:
        description: Confirm production promotion (GOV-007)
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false
      dry_run:
        description: Dry run (print plan, no changes)
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: true
jobs:
  promote-build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      actions: write
    steps:
    - name: Validate promotion path
      run: "FROM=\"${{ inputs.from_env }}\"\nTO=\"${{ inputs.to_env }}\"\nif [ \"$FROM\" = \"dev\" ] && [ \"$TO\" = \"qa\" ]; then\n  echo \"Valid: dev -> qa\"\nelif [ \"$FROM\" = \"qa\" ] && [ \"$TO\" = \"prod\" ]; then\n  echo \"Valid: qa -> prod\"\n  if [ \"${{ inputs.confirm_prod }}\" != \"true\" ]; then\n    echo \"ERROR: Production promotion requires confirm_prod=true (GOV-007)\"\n    exit 1\n  fi\nelse\n  echo \"ERROR: Invalid promotion path: $FROM -> $TO\"\n  echo \"Valid paths: dev->qa, qa->prod\"\n  exit 1\nfi\n"
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
      with:
        fetch-depth: 0
        token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v5
      with:
        python-version: '3.12'
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: pip install -r Code/Shared/ops/tools/requirements.txt
    - name: Merge source branch into target branch
      if: inputs.dry_run == false
      run: 'BRANCH_MAP_dev="dev"

        BRANCH_MAP_qa="qa"

        BRANCH_MAP_prod="main"


        FROM_BRANCH="BRANCH_MAP_${{ inputs.from_env }}"

        TO_BRANCH="BRANCH_MAP_${{ inputs.to_env }}"

        SRC="${!FROM_BRANCH}"

        DST="${!TO_BRANCH}"


        git config user.email "skip.snow@gmail.com"

        git config user.name "SkipSnow"


        echo "Merging $SRC -> $DST"

        git checkout "$DST"

        git merge "origin/$SRC" -m "Promote ${{ inputs.from_env }} -> ${{ inputs.to_env }} (build promotion)"

        git push origin "$DST"

        '
    - name: Trigger deploy.yml for target env
      if: inputs.dry_run == false
      env:
        GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      run: 'BR="${{ inputs.to_env }}"

        if [ "$BR" = "prod" ]; then BR="main"; fi

        gh workflow run deploy.yml --ref "$BR"

        echo "Dispatched deploy.yml on $BR"

        '
    - name: Dry run summary
      if: inputs.dry_run == true
      env:
        MONGO_FRONTEND_connectionString: ${{ secrets.MONGO_FRONTEND_connectionString }}
      run: "python Code/Shared/ops/promote_build.py \\\n  --from ${{ inputs.from_env }} \\\n  --to ${{ inputs.to_env }} \\\n  --dry-run\n"

steps.name: Validate promotion path
steps.run:
FROM="${{ inputs.from_env }}"
TO="${{ inputs.to_env }}"
if [ "$FROM" = "dev" ] && [ "$TO" = "qa" ]; then
  echo "Valid: dev -> qa"
elif [ "$FROM" = "qa" ] && [ "$TO" = "prod" ]; then
  echo "Valid: qa -> prod"
  if [ "${{ inputs.confirm_prod }}" != "true" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: Production promotion requires confirm_prod=true (GOV-007)"
    exit 1
  fi
else
  echo "ERROR: Invalid promotion path: $FROM -> $TO"
  echo "Valid paths: dev->qa, qa->prod"
  exit 1
fi

steps.name: Merge source branch into target branch
steps.run:
BRANCH_MAP_dev="dev"
BRANCH_MAP_qa="qa"
BRANCH_MAP_prod="main"

FROM_BRANCH="BRANCH_MAP_${{ inputs.from_env }}"
TO_BRANCH="BRANCH_MAP_${{ inputs.to_env }}"
SRC="${!FROM_BRANCH}"
DST="${!TO_BRANCH}"

git config user.email "skip.snow@gmail.com"
git config user.name "SkipSnow"

echo "Merging $SRC -> $DST"
git checkout "$DST"
git merge "origin/$SRC" -m "Promote ${{ inputs.from_env }} -> ${{ inputs.to_env }} (build promotion)"
git push origin "$DST"

steps.name: Trigger deploy.yml for target env
steps.run:
BR="${{ inputs.to_env }}"
if [ "$BR" = "prod" ]; then BR="main"; fi
gh workflow run deploy.yml --ref "$BR"
echo "Dispatched deploy.yml on $BR"

        description: Source environment
        required: true

        - dev

    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v5
      with:
        python-version: '3.12'

    - name: Run data promotion

      run: "DRY_RUN_FLAG=\"\"\nif [ \"${{ inputs.dry_run }}\" = \"true\" ]; then\n  DRY_RUN_FLAG=\"--dry-run\"\nfi\npython Code/Shared/ops/promote_data.py \\\n  --from ${{ inputs.from_env }} \\\n  --to ${{ inputs.to_env }} \\\n  $DRY_RUN_FLAG\n"

FROM="${{ inputs.from_env }}"
TO="${{ inputs.to_env }}"
if [ "$FROM" = "dev" ] && [ "$TO" = "qa" ]; then

steps.run:

  DRY_RUN_FLAG="--dry-run"
fi
python Code/Shared/ops/promote_data.py \

  --to ${{ inputs.to_env }} \
  $DRY_RUN_FLAG
